text:
Maya: Hot take: office chairs should come with a built-in sock drawer. Who's with me? :socks:
Ravi: Absolutely not. Socks belong on feet, not in chair archaeology. :laughing:
Noah: Quick poll: react with :one: for socks, :two: for slippers, :three: for barefoot vibes.
Tess: I'm going barefoot on principle. :footprints: 3 from me.
Olivia: 2 for slippers. Combat-ready and cozy.
Maya: Adding a one-liner incentive: best shoe-related quip wins a mystery muffin. Drop your one-liners below.
Ravi: "Sock it to me, gently." Too dramatic? :sweat_smile:
Noah: "Slippers: for when you mean business, softly"
Tess: "Barefoot and brainstorming." Short and true.
Olivia: "Chair storage: where lost pens and socks become legends." :scroll:
cleaning-bot: Reminder: please store personal laundry items in lockers, not on chair backs. Weekly clean on Fridays.
Maya: Tally so far: 1 vs 2 vs 3 1. Close race. Voting open until 4pm.
Ravi: PS: if you win the muffin, you must perform your one-liner into the mic at the next all-hands. :microphone:
Noah: Deal. If I win I'm doing an interpretive dance too. :man_dancing:
Tess: Whoever coined 'chair archaeology' is getting a sticker."
